title: State Department UAP Cable 2, Kazakhstan, January 31, 1994
doc_notes: This document is a diplomatic cable from the U.S. Embassy in Dushanbe reporting a pilot encounter with an unidentified aerial object over Kazakhstan.

incidents.summary: Three American pilots and one Tajik pilot flying a Boeing 747SP over Kazakhstan observed a high-altitude object performing extreme maneuvers.
incidents.explanation: The crew rejected the possibility of a meteor, suggesting it was extraterrestrial and under intelligent control.
incidents.quote: resembling a high-speed photo of a bullet in flight
incidents.size: small object with large trailing wave
